body_note: The PoC body is not redistributed. verify_pocs.py restores the audited test tree after each run, so the materialised body is not recoverable; for repo_native_test rows it is unlicensed upstream source. Reconstruct it from poc_materialised_file / poc_native_location at audited_commit, or from the code quoted in the public report.
fixed_revision_note: This is a single-revision run at the audited commit. It is NOT one of the pinpoint vulnerable-vs-fixed experiments in experiments/<finding>__*/{vulnerable,fixed}/ and does not establish that a patch was effective.
poc_type_note: PoC body reconstructed from the code quoted in the public Code4rena report and written into the audited repository's test tree for the run.
verdict_meaning: The PoC could not be brought to a verdict in this environment. The run failure reason records the specific cause; no claim is made either way.
